$description: Closed asset-role / destination-role registry. Roles used in PageSpec fields are exactly these names; clone policies and generation availability are pinned in code (PINNED_POLICIES + PINNED_AVAILABILITY in extraction/verify_all.py AND schema/semantic_validate.py) so a role cannot silently be moved to a different-but-valid policy. ONE list 'roles' holds every role; 'class' is asset | destination | form-endpoint | content.
legalNotice: primefold.ai is a live commercial site. Primefold-owned assets (logo, wordmark, product badges, site icons, artwork) may be reused ONLY in mode 'clone' (a faithful reconstruction of Primefold); in mode 'generation' (a page for any other brand) none of them may be reused (availability clone-only / blocked-for-generation, enforced by GENERATION_MODE_* rules). Third-party customer logos/imagery and real people are placeholder-only in both modes. The clone's reference/study-only status is recorded in policy/design-policy.json sourceUsage (the project README no longer states it).

availabilityMeaning.clone-only: Primefold's own identity assets: reusable verbatim in mode 'clone' only; the role is rejected in mode 'generation'.
availabilityMeaning.generation-safe: May appear in mode 'generation' with the role's generationAssetSources (never 'reuse-exact' of a Primefold original).
availabilityMeaning.blocked-for-generation: Real third-party identity / live third-party target: rejected in mode 'generation'; placeholder-only in mode 'clone'.

Literal URLs in a PageSpec must use the reserved placeholder domains .example / .invalid (RFC 2606), e.g. https://www.northwind.example/help. Any other domain, and every Primefold/third-party URL from the source, is rejected (GENERATION_MODE_URL).

All visible text is newly written for the new brand. Any 5-word run that matches Primefold source copy (hashed shingles in schema/source-patterns.json), any Primefold product/brand name, real person, real customer or source statistic is rejected (GENERATION_MODE_COPY / _BRAND / _PERSON / _CUSTOMER / _CLAIM).

fontFaces.licensing: MANIFEST: 'Google Fonts v1, latin'. Confirm the licence before redistributing.
MANIFEST: Google Fonts v1 latin. Confirm the licence.
Widely distributed open-source family; confirm the licence text before redistributing.

TRIAL licence ('Trial' in the family name). A trial font is for evaluation only: it must not be shipped in production or in a redistributed package; purchase the commercial licence or replace it with a licensed face. Used for outcome digits, intelligence-card titles and phone hero/testimonial titles.

realIdentities.$description: Deny-list for fields flagged placeholderOnly in section contracts. Generated PageSpecs must not contain any of these strings (whole-word, case-insensitive) in those fields. 'people' (full names) match whole-word anywhere in the field; 'peopleFirstNamesOnly' match only when the entire field value equals the name, so common first names do not reject unrelated placeholder text.

realProprietaryCopyRule: Third-party-attributed copy (customer quotes, outcome claims such as '5x', '150 customers', '1 hour', named testimonials) must be replaced by clearly generic placeholder text in generated output. Primefold's own marketing copy is documented in the example only because the home example reproduces the owner's own page.
